metrics.label: Investment advisory firms
metrics.denominator: Current monthly SEC IARD RIA + ERA firm facts (form_adv_firm_facts)
metrics.description: SEC/IARD monthly roster firms. RIA and ERA stay separate classes. Not all canonical firm identities.

trace.counts: One current form_adv_firm_facts row per CRD in the monthly RIA+ERA pair.
trace.doesNotCount: Not 2155 extra canonical firms without ADV facts. Not Form ADV filings. Not attribute rows. Not CRD identifiers as additional firms.
trace.geographicCoverage: National SEC IARD roster; principal office is not service territory

metrics.label: Registered investment adviser records
metrics.description: RIA firm facts on the current roster. Includes pending. ERA is not an RIA.

trace.doesNotCount: Not ERA. Pending is not SEC approval. Not a quality ranking.

metrics.label: Exempt reporting adviser records
metrics.description: ERA firm facts. ERA is not an RIA. Exemption from full registration is not a safety finding.

trace.doesNotCount: Not RIAs. Not a combined “advisers” total without stating both classes.

metrics.label: Form ADV filings

trace.doesNotCount: Not firms. Not attribute observations. Amendments are not new advisers.

metrics.label: Form ADV attribute observations

metrics.label: RIA firms with a reported RAUM observation
metrics.denominator: RIA facts with Item 5F(2)(c) RAUM present (zero kept distinct from missing)

trace.counts: RIA facts with a non-null RAUM amount. Zero is a reported value.
trace.doesNotCount: Not performance. Not client assets as a marketing total. Not ERA. Not a summed national AUM headline.
